description: Using the James Webb Space Telescope, astronomers have mapped buckyballs in a distant nebula. These complex carbon molecules, arranged in a shell, could offer clues to the chemistry that underpins life in the universe.
title: James Webb Space Telescope Reveals Cosmic Buckyballs in Distant Nebula

description: Ubisoft revealed Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced last week. The company is confirmed to be working on multiple remakes of older Assassin's Creed games. The next remake could revisit the first Assassin's Creed title. According to a leak, Ubisoft is reportedly working on an AC 1 remake.
title: Remake of First Assassin's Creed Game Said to Be in the Works at Ubisoft

description: Smartwatches with AMOLED displays under Rs. 3,000 now offer a solid mix of features, including Bluetooth calling, fitness tracking, and long battery life. Options like the boAt Chrome Horizon focus on features, while the Redmi Watch Move stands out for battery and software. The boAt Enigma Radiant and Noise Halo 2 prioritise design, and the Ultima Prime and Fastrack Astor FR2 Pro offer balanced performance. Most models include Always-On Display, multiple sports modes, and health tracking, though overall experience still varies. We've handpicked the best smart watches for men, boys, and other users.
title: Top Budget Smartwatches with AMOLED Display Under Rs 3,000

description: Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G competes with the OnePlus Pad Go 2 and Realme Pad 3 in the Indian market. All three models feature larger displays with a 120Hz refresh rate and feature quad speakers. Here is a detailed comparison of Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G, OnePlus Pad Go 2 and Realme Pad 3 based on their pricing in India and key specifications.
title: Redmi Pad 2 Pro 5G vs OnePlus Pad Go 2 vs Realme Pad 3: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: GoBoult has launched the Bassbox Rave Q5, Rave Q10, and Groove 12, 14, and 20 speakers in India. The lineup includes compact and high-output models with features such as dynamic bass drivers, TWS pairing, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity. The Rave series focuses on portability, while the Groove series offers dual drivers, BoomX bass technology, and up to 20W output. Select models include RGB lighting, and all speakers are designed for indoor and outdoor use with water-resistant builds and multi-input support.
title: GoBoult Rave Q5, Rave Q10 Launched in India Alongside New Groove Series Speakers: Price, Features

description: OnePlus Buds Ace 3 has launched in China alongside the OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra, offering features like 55dB ANC, LHDC 5.0 audio, and a 12mm dynamic driver. The earbuds support spatial audio, FPS-tuned sound effects, and 47ms low latency for gaming. They also include Bluetooth 6.0, AI call noise reduction, and dual-device connectivity. The earbuds are claimed to deliver up to 54 hours of battery life and come with IP55 rating, fast charging support, and touch controls with slide gestures.
title: OnePlus Buds Ace 3 Launched With Up to 55dB ANC, Up to 54 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin traded near $76,900 on Tuesday amid macro uncertainty and profit-taking. Analysts say the market remains range-bound, with $75,000 acting as support and $80,000 as resistance. Institutional demand continues to provide underlying support.
title: Bitcoin Price Drops Under $77,000 as Macroeconomic Uncertainty and Profit Booking Weigh on Prices

description: Happy Raj is a simple and emotional romantic drama about love, family, and new beginnings.
title: Happy Raj Now Available For Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: Redmi Pad 2 9.7 has been launched in select global markets. The new compact tablet is currently available for purchase in Malaysia and Singapore via the Xiaomi online store in Graphite Gray and Silver colour options. The latest Redmi Pad 2 9.7 is powered by Qualcomm’s 6nm octa core Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 chipset, along with an Adreno 610 GPU, 4GB of LPDDR4x RAM, and up to 128GB of UFS 2.2 onboard storage. It also features a 9.7-inch 2K display, offering up to 120Hz of refresh rate. The tablet has been equipped with a 7,600mAh battery.
title: Redmi Pad 2 9.7 Launched Globally With 2K Display, 7,600mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Google on Tuesday announced the expansion of its digital identity efforts in India with the rollout of support for Aadhaar credentials in Google Wallet. This feature, as described by the Mountain View-based tech giant, allows users to store a digital version of their Aadhaar card, issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), on their smartphones. Google says it offers a more convenient way to verify identity without having to carry a physical document.
title: Google Wallet Adds Support for Aadhaar Digital ID in India With Support for In-Person and Remote Verification

description: The Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 has been launched in India. It runs on the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and offers several AI features. The new tablet has a 13-inch display with 3.5K resolution and Dolby Vision support. The tablet includes a quad JBL audio unit with Dolby Atmos support. It has a 13-megapixel rear camera and a 10,200mAh battery with 45W charging support
title: Lenovo Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 Launched in India With Snapdragon 8s Gen 4, 10,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Band Melam is a rural romantic drama about two childhood friends whose lives take different paths before fate reunites them.
title: Band Melam Out on OTT Now: Where to Watch This Rural Romantic Drama Online?

description: iQOO 15T will be launched in China in May by the Vivo sub-brand, a tipster claims. Additionally, the tech firm reportedly also plans to launch its new flagship tablet in the same month, which could be marketed as the iQOO Pad 6 Pro. Along with the launch timeline, the leaker has also shared the key specifications of the two devices. The iQOO 15T is claimed to be powered by the flagship 3nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC, while the iQOO Pad 6 Pro could be equipped with Qualcomm’s 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: iQOO 15T, iQOO Pad 6 Pro Launch Timeline Tipped Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: Embark Studios has detailed the Riven Tides update coming to Arc Raiders on April 28. The major update finally adds a new map to the extraction shooter. Arc Raiders also gets a new Arc threat, new player project, minor map condition, cosmetics, in-game items and more.
title: Arc Raiders' Riven Tides Update With New Map and Arc Machine Arrives April 28

description: Canada has proposed a bill to ban political donations made using cryptocurrency as part of broader election finance reforms. The move aims to improve transparency and reduce risks linked to traceability and compliance, reflecting increasing regulatory scrutiny of digital assets in the country.
title: Canada's Bill C-25 Clears Key Vote as Government Moves to Block Crypto Political Donations

description: iQOO Neo 10 will launch in a new Alpine White colour variant in India on April 30. iQOO has shared a poster on X showcasing the phone in a new shade. The phone is already available in Inferno Red and Titanium Chrome finishes in India. It runs on a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and features a 7,000mAh battery with 120W fast charging support. The iQOO Neo 10 has a dual rear camera unit and a 32-megapixel selfie shooter.
title: iQOO Neo 10 Will Soon Be Available in Two New Colour Variants in India

description: JC: The University follows a college student whose life turns dark after a false case pushes him into the world of crime.
title: JC: The University Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About This Kannada Crime Drama

description: Musician Taylor Swift has reportedly filed to trademark her voice and image. As per reports, the move comes amid rising artificial intelligence (AI)-generated deepfakes that, in particular, have affected celebrities and public figures. The pop superstar is said to have filed applications to trademark two samples of her audio and an image of her performing on the stage during her Eras tour.
title: Taylor Swift Files to Trademark Voice, Image to Protect Her Likeness From AI Deepfakes: Report

description: Samsung has been rumoured to be developing Exynos 2700 as its next-generation flagship-grade mobile processor and the successor to the Exynos 2600. While there are still ways to go before devices powered by this chipset make it to the market, the rumour mill has already begun churning out details about the potential upgrades. A recent report suggests that Exynos 2700 could bring about notable changes in design and thermal management, potentially resulting in cooler device performance.
title: Samsung Exynos 2700 Will Reportedly Feature New SoC, DRAM Packaging for Improved Thermal Management

description: Google expanded the support for digital identity verification in India with the introduction of the ability to add an Aadhaar card to Google Wallet. This came as part of the tech giant’s collaboration with the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). Now, users in India can produce their Aadhaar card at movie theatres to verify their age, on matrimonial sites for identification, and to auto-fill visa applications. The company also plans to partner with Mygate and Snabbit in the future. The ability eliminates the need for users to produce a physical PVC card for their Aadhaar verification.
title: How to Add Aadhaar Card to Google Wallet: A Step-By-Step Guide

description: The OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra was launched in China on Tuesday. It joins the OnePlus Ace 6 and Ace 6T in the brand’s latest performance-focused smartphone lineup. The handset sports a 1.5K resolution AMOLED screen with a 165Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, paired with up to 16GB of RAM. On the camera front, OnePlus has equipped the phone with a 50-megapixel dual rear camera unit. The OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra packs an 8,600mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chip Alongside Controller Accessory: Price, Features

description: Motorola Razr 70 series renders have surfaced online, revealing updated design and finish options ahead of launch. Shared by a tipster, the images show the Razr 70 in green and grey textured finishes, while the Razr 70 Ultra appears in blue fabric-like and wooden variants. The design remains similar to earlier leaks. The Ultra model is tipped to feature a 7-inch inner display and a 4-inch cover screen, along with a slim profile and premium material options.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Series Design, Colour Options Revealed in Fresh Leak

description: Nothing has announced the addition of Cloud storage to its Essential Space feature via a blog post. With the latest update, users can now back up and sync their Essential Space content through their Nothing account. This enables notes, screenshots, voice recordings, images, tasks, and summaries to stay connected across supported devices. The rollout started and will reach all 2025–2026 Nothing and CMF smartphones that support the Essential Key.
title: Nothing's Essential Space Updated With Cloud Storage for Data Backup,  Sync Across Handsets

description: Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro could be launched in late May, according to a report. The tech giant will reportedly start the promotional campaign for the handsets on May 29, which is said to run till June 30. Along with the launch date, the pricing, storage configurations, and the colour options of the two models have surfaced online. The standard Xiaomi 17T is said to go on sale in 12GB + 256GB and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations, while the Pro model could go on sale in 12GB + 512GB and 12GB + 1TB options.
title: Xiaomi 17T, Xiaomi 17T Pro Price and Colour Options Leaked Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: Israel’s regulator has approved a shekel-pegged stablecoin by Bits of Gold after a two-year pilot. The BILS token will operate under strict conditions, with reserves held in segregated local accounts, as authorities move towards regulated crypto adoption.
title: Israel's Regulatory Authority Approves Shekel-Pegged Stablecoin After Pilot on Solana Blockchain

description: Apple’s latest iPhone 17 series is said to have run into a potential issue affecting several users. According to recent reports and online user discussions, some units are allegedly failing to power back on after their batteries are completely drained. It seems to affect all models in the Cupertino-based tech giant’s latest lineup, including the iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone Air.
title: iPhone 17 Series Reportedly Affected By Issue That Prevents Booting When Batteries Are Drained

description: Samsung unveiled the Trips feature in Samsung Wallet. This allows Galaxy users a single place to keep their trip details organised and stay one step ahead as their plans unfold. The new feature introduces a Trip timeline that displays all travel-related details in a single view. The Trips feature supports hotel bookings, flight details, car rentals, and excursions. It will be available to Galaxy phone users in select markets, including the US, UK, and Korea.
title: Samsung Wallet Update Adds ‘Trips’ Feature With Unified View of All Travel Plans

description: OpenAI and Microsoft’s exclusive partnership is now officially over. On Monday, both companies announced several changes to their existing deal, removing key exclusivity clauses. Additionally, the amended partnership has also ended the vaguely worded artificial general intelligence (AGI) clause, which dictated several “if-this-then-that” scenarios. The new agreement is now clearer and lets both companies better safeguard their interests.
title: OpenAI, Microsoft Make Major Changes to Partnership, Remove the AGI Clause

description: Elon Musk is reportedly close to launching X Money, a payments and banking service built into X. The feature is said to be nearing early public access and may include peer-to-peer transfers, a debit card, and an AI assistant for tracking expenses. Early users have mentioned perks such as cashback and higher savings interest rates. However, key details remain unclear, and the platform is still facing regulatory hurdles in several US states before a wider rollout.
title: Elon Musk Reportedly Preparing to Launch X Money Soon With Payments, Banking Features

description: Kartavya is an action drama about a sincere police officer torn between protecting his family and fulfilling his duty.
title: Kartavya OTT Release Reportedly Revealed Online: When and Where to Watch Saif Ali Khan Starrer Online?

description: Valve has confirmed the price and release date of the new Steam controller. The company's next-gen gamepad will launch in select regions on May 4 at 10am PT. The Steam controller is priced $99 (9,350) in the US. It will be available in the US, the UK, Canada, the EU, Australia, Japan, Taiwan, Soth Korea, and Hong Kong.
title: Valve Announces Steam Controller Release Date and Price, Says Will Share Update on Steam Machine Soon

description: Apple's next CEO, John Ternus, is scheduled to take charge of the Cupertino-based tech giant on September 1. During a town hall meeting last, Ternus reportedly assured Apple employees that he plans to expand the Apple Services portfolio further, while highlighting the role Apple Pay has planned in transforming the way people buy things. Ternus will also oversee the launch of various new product categories, including the foldable iPhone, foldable iPad, AI-powered smart hub, and the rumoured touchscreen MacBook.
title: Apple's Next CEO John Ternus Reportedly Pledges to Expand Apple’s Services Portfolio

description: Vivo TWS 5i has launched in China as an affordable pair of true wireless earbuds with a 10mm dynamic driver and DeepX 3.0 stereo sound. It supports spatial audio, Bluetooth 5.4 dual-device connectivity, and AI-based call noise reduction. The earbuds offer up to 50 hours of total battery life and up to 42ms low latency for gaming. Additional features include BlueOS integration, instant pairing, and real-time translation. The earbuds are priced at CNY 119 (roughly Rs. 1,600) and come in three colour options.
title: Vivo TWS 5i Launched With 10mm Dynamic Drivers, Up to 50 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Poco C81 Pro has been launched in select global markets with a 6,000mAh battery. It runs on a Unisoc T7250 chipset alongside 4GB RAM and up to 256GB storage. The Poco C81 Pro sports an AI-backed rear camera unit, including a 13-megapixel primary sensor. It features a 6,000mAh battery and supports 15W fast charging and has  6.9-inch HD+ (720x1,600 pixels) LCD panel with up to 120 Hz refresh rate.
title: Poco C81 Pro Launched With 6,000mAh Battery, 6.9-Inch Display and Unisoc T7250 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Apple will market its first book-style foldable smartphone as the iPhone Ultra, according to a report citing industry sources. This corroborates earlier reports that the Cupertino-based tech giant is planning to adopt the Ultra branding for its rumoured foldable, which is expected to sit above iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models. The purported iPhone Ultra will not arrive as part of the iPhone 18 lineup, which means it will not have the number 18 in its name, similar to last year’s iPhone Air. On top of this, the company will reportedly also call the rumoured MacBook model with an OLED touchscreen as the MacBook Ultra.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans to Launch Foldable iPhone, Touchscreen MacBook ‘Ultra’ This Year

description: Spotify on Monday marked its foray into the guided workouts space with the introduction of the “Fitness with Spotify” experience. The Swedish music streaming platform is rolling out structured fitness content, guided sessions, and wellness-focused media into its existing ecosystem of music, podcasts, audiobooks, and video. This potentially puts Spotify in more direct competition with Apple Fitness+ and Fitbit. The new feature is rolling out to both free and Premium users, with additional content available to subscribers through partnerships.
title: Spotify Takes on Apple Fitness+, Fitbit With New Guided Workout Experience

description: Samsung is said to be preparing to introduce its first pair of extended reality (XR) glasses later this year. Details about the purported product have surfaced online ahead of any official announcement. According to a report, the smart glasses could be inspired by existing competitors' devices, such as the Ray-Ban Meta Smart Glasses, in terms of design. With its launch, the South Korean tech conglomerate is expected to expand its Android XR ecosystem beyond the previously unveiled Samsung Galaxy XR.
title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses to Reportedly Feature Ray-Ban Meta-Like Design, Gemini Integration

description: Starfield has finally arrived on PS5, along with a major update that promises to streamline the fragmented space travel experience. There are several other quality-of-life improvements and a wide berth of new features that, Bethesda claims, make the latest iteration of the game the “most complete and evolved Starfield experience.” But if you’re expecting the major update, dubbed Free Lanes, to act as panacea for all of Starfield’s ills, you will likely be disappointed.
title: Starfield PS5 Review: Bethesda's Flawed Interstellar RPG Rewards Patience
